text:
Elena S: customer (acme-analytics) reports EU users suddenly routed to us-west for ~15m, big latency & billing spike. they saw retries + some 500s
Jamal R: can you paste the healthcheck timeline / failover alert?
Elena S: healthbot shows failover at 08:12:03 UTC. customer logs show requests tagged eu-west but responses from us-west. also a few 403s around 08:10-08:11 (auth rotate?)
healthbot: AUTO: deploy-monitor: route-failover eu-west -> us-west triggered; reason=3 consecutive probe misses (agent-heartbeat 08:11:40 -> 08:12:00)
Priya K: fyi we had a config push yesterday that changed probe sampling on some agents (25s -> 5s). sampling skew + auth rotate can create a window where probes miss. check `heartbeat.sample_interval` vs `probe.ttl`
Carlos M: i can reproduce locally by simulating packet loss. repro: run prober with `--interval=5s --ttl=10s` and drop ~33% packets -> probes miss and route flips
Elena S: customer wants quick mitigation and billing remediation suggestions
Jamal R: short term: increase probe tolerance for eu-west (misses threshold -> 5) and pin routing for their account (premium) to prefer eu-west. i'll roll a canary rollback for the agent config to restore `heartbeat.sample_interval=25s` on eu-west probes
Priya K: also check auth rotate job at ~08:10 — those 403s might correlate. if token rotate overlaps with tightened sampling you'll see concurrent probe failures
healthbot: NOTE: rollback canary queued by Jamal at 08:20 UTC
Carlos M: adding repro snippet to ticket for support:
```
# simulate loss
tc qdisc add dev eth0 root netem loss 33%
# run prober
./tools/health-prober --interval 5s --ttl 10s
# curl health
curl -v https://eu.health.redwood.example/health
```
Elena S: i'll update the customer, ask them to confirm token rotate timing and offer account credit for the billing spike. thanks all
Jamal R: i'll monitor canary and add an alert to detect mismatches between control-plane sample_interval and agent runtime. will post status here when done
